section.title: Activity
section.para: To get snacks for a class trip, Clare went to the “bulk” section of the grocery store, where she could buy any quantity of a product and the prices are usually good.
Clare purchased some salted almonds at $6 a pound and some dried figs at $9 per pound. She spent $75 before tax.

list.item: If she bought 2 pounds of almonds, how many pounds of figs did she buy?
If she bought 1 pound of figs, how many pounds of almonds did she buy?

div.para:
\(6a+9f=75\)
\(a\): pounds of almonds, \(f\): pounds of figs
For questions 4 and 5, use the graph that represents the quantities in the situation.

list.item: Write an equation that describes the relationship between pounds of figs and pounds of almonds that Clare bought and the dollar amount that she paid. Be sure to specify what the variables represent.

section.para: For questions 4 and 5, use the graph that represents the quantities in the situation.

image.alt: Graph of 2 intersecting lines and 5 points, origin O, with grid. Almonds (pounds) and dried figs (pounds).

div.para:
Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
Point A or (2, 7). Clare bought 2 pounds of almonds and 7 pounds of figs for a total of $75.

list.item: Choose any point on the line, state its coordinates, and explain what it tells us.

div.para:
Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
Point D or \((1, 1)\). Clare bought 1 pound of almonds and 1 pound of figs, and the total was not $75.
